_note: Viewer types, who comes from where, comment words, sound effects and the reason table used by Mr. Algo (3 Things). Add a type or a reason here.

reviewText.colour: Not the colour in the video.
reviewText.sticker: It said only 2 left. It was not true.

deadair.label: Left in dead air
deadair.bad: People left while nothing happened on screen.
deadair.good: You cut the dead air. People stayed.
deadair.next: Trim the quiet start and end of each clip. Keep the answer.

what.label: Did not know what it was
what.bad: People left without knowing what the product was.
what.good: The first seconds said what it was.
what.next: Open with a clear shot of the product. Use a hold-up or close-up as the hook.

why.label: No reason to care
why.bad: People saw it but did not see why they would want it.
why.good: People saw why they would want it.
why.next: Show a result or a feeling. Try before and after, or in use.

works.label: Not sure it works
works.bad: People wanted to see it work and did not.
works.good: The demo showed that it works.
works.next: Add a demo in hands for function products. Show size with a hand.

trust.label: Did not trust it
trust.bad: People did not trust what they saw.
trust.next: Show the real product in clear light. Unbox it or talk to camera.

get.label: No price, no link
get.bad: People wanted to buy but never saw the price.
get.good: The price was easy to find.
get.next: Add a price card, or show the price on the first or last clip.

length.label: Moved on
length.bad: Some viewers had what they came for and moved on.
length.good: Most people watched to the end.
length.next: Keep it tight. Cut clips that repeat the same answer.

colour.label: Colour looked wrong
colour.bad: The colour looked different from the real product.
colour.next: Use window light in the day, or a ring light. Skip the vivid filter.

market.label: Hard timing
market.bad: The topic was cold or crowded when you posted.
market.good: You posted when buyers were looking.
market.next: Check the feeds and the Seller Hub. Post when buyers are asking, before rivals flood in.

site.label: Site did not fit the moment
site.bad: This site did not suit the topic at that moment.
site.next: Try the other site. Short video wins at the peak. Long video wins before it and after it.

stock.label: No stock
stock.bad: People wanted to buy and you had nothing on the shelf.
stock.next: Order stock before you post. Check the shelves.

honest.label: Misleading
honest.bad: Buyers returned the product. The video promised more than the product gave.
honest.next: Show the real colour. Skip fake stickers.

sales.label: Sales
sales.bad: Views came, but few people bought.
sales.next: Check the price shot and the trust shot.
